chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: Arriving for Varsity Show with nothing written
summary: They had no material, would take only the picture job, and made up their scenes themselves.

blocks.x: Now "Varsity Show" is -- I assume that since you said when you got there they had nothing for you to do.
Could you tell me a little bit about that?

That's it. They had nothing and we didn't do nothing. I wouldn't take no other job but the picture job. That's what I came back from England for to do the picture job. Either that or nothing. So we got the job in the picture, so we did the picture. Picture is over now if there's a job, okay, we'll take the job.
When you first arrived on the set for "Varsity Show" they had no script for you at all.

create something from scratch yourself. Yeah. Did I tell you the story about the Loews State about the Ritz Brothers, I told you that, didn't I? Yes, I did, I'm sure I did. Did I tell you about going to the restaurant to get coffee, outside the stage door and all, come in about Ziegfeld and all? I told you about that?
